description: This file implements the core logic of the DU (Distributed Unit) RAN resource management, including resource allocation, deallocation, and configuration updates for UEs and cells within a 5G network. It defines classes and functions for managing radio resources, handling UE context updates, and interfacing with other modules like SRS, PUCCH, and bearer management.

classes.name: du_ue_ran_resource_updater_impl
classes.description: Implements the updater for UE RAN resources, allowing updates and configuration application for a specific UE.

classes.name: du_ran_resource_manager_impl
classes.description: Manages RAN resources for multiple cells and UEs, including allocation, deallocation, and configuration updates.

classes.name: du_ran_resource_manager_impl::ue_resource_context
classes.description: Holds the context for a UE's radio resources within the RAN, including capabilities and configuration.

methods.name: du_ue_ran_resource_updater_impl::update
methods.description: Updates the UE's radio resource context based on new configuration requests.

methods.name: du_ue_ran_resource_updater_impl::config_applied
methods.description: Signals that the UE configuration has been applied, triggering parent updates.

methods.name: build_srs_res_mng
methods.description: Constructs the appropriate SRS resource manager based on cell configuration.

methods.name: du_ran_resource_manager_impl::create_ue_resource_configurator
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new UE resource configurator, allocating necessary resources.

methods.name: du_ran_resource_manager_impl::update_context
methods.description: Updates the context of a UE, including resource deallocation and reallocation based on new configuration.

methods.name: du_ran_resource_manager_impl::deallocate_context
methods.description: Deallocates all resources associated with a specific UE.

methods.name: du_ran_resource_manager_impl::ue_config_applied
methods.description: Handles post-configuration steps after UE resources are applied.

methods.name: du_ran_resource_manager_impl::allocate_cell_resources
methods.description: Allocates radio resources for a specific cell and UE.

methods.name: du_ran_resource_manager_impl::deallocate_cell_resources
methods.description: Deallocates radio resources for a specific cell and UE.
